Name: Blob The Fish
Author: Loolooland
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]it adds a Cute new little fish that can be caught on the beach year round always![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]1.Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]2. Install this mod and move it into your Mods Folder[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]3. play and have Fun![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]No other requirements[/color][/size]
